content: The tested external-camera table fit is a rejected candidate: separate-recording plane RMSE improves only 3.26% and 1.74%. Do not use it as an accepted twin calibration or evidence of contact recovery.
applicability: original Piper scene and this station external RGB-D; fixed table ROIs; only normal/distance observable
limitations: Three frames per episode, same physical camera and workstation; not cross-installation validation
RGB-D systematic bias persists across episodes; no external metrology
Table world z=25 mm and CAD world XY/yaw remain fixed assumptions
No calibrated aperture, contact force, friction, mass or COM
No real motion or new task rollout; camera load check does not measure task success
